bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'GSERVER_HEAD='
git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'GSERVER_STATUS='
git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no | wc -l
printf 'CREATE_VIDEO_RUNTIME_PROBE\n'
printf 'REPO_CONTEXT='
pwd
git remote get-url origin
printf 'VIDEO_CONTAINERS\n'
docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Image}} {{.Status}}' | grep -Ei 'videobot|creator|sticker' || true
printf 'VIDEO_IMAGE\n'
docker image ls --format '{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}}' | grep -Ei 'videobot' || true
